help.title: 📖 Bot help
help.body: General commands /start open the main menu /help this help /lang change language /id show your id /stats bot statistics /ticket open a support ticket /mytickets list your tickets
help.admin_body: Moderation commands (groups only) /admin group panel /rules show the group rules /warn reply + warn /unwarn clear warnings /warns warning count /mute temporary mute /unmute unmute /ban ban and remove /unban unban /kick remove from group /purge delete messages /pin pin the replied message /tickets list open tickets /reply answer a ticket /close close a ticket
help.owner_body: Owner commands /broadcast send a message to everyone /togglebot enable/disable the bot /maintenance maintenance mode /audit recent actions /backup create a backup /adminpanel owner panel
